findings.title: Search with no matches leaves the previous results and count on screen
findings.description: A search must show its outcome, including an empty result. search() calls render() and updates the status only when list.length is non-zero; with zero matches it returns silently, so the earlier result list (on first search, all ten tools) remains and the live status is not updated. There is no empty-state markup.
findings.impact: A member searching for a tool the library does not hold may believe the unrelated tools shown are matches, and screen-reader users hear nothing.

findings.recommendation: Always render; on zero matches show an empty state naming the query with a way to clear filters, and set the status to 'No tools found'.

findings.title: Loan-length listbox captures Tab and has no Escape or outside-click close

The keydown handler on #loan-list calls preventDefault on Tab and moves to the next option (wrapping), so Tab and Shift+Tab never leave the open list; Escape is not handled; clicking elsewhere does not close it. The only exits are choosing an option (Enter, Space, click) or re-clicking the button.
findings.impact: Keyboard users who open the list to check the options may be unable to Tab out without changing their choice, and are not told how to leave.

findings.title: Wide layouts leave the right half empty and footer bands stop short

findings.title: Done page has no focal point marking the reservation, and the basket count persists
